item.title: [New] Copilot users can keep using premium models after the licence limit by drawing Copilot Credits; spending policies decide who may (GA December)
item.description:
Not a security change; a cost control that needs a spending policy so usage beyond the licence is a decision, not a default.

Copilot · Set a Copilot Credits spending policy before December.

item.title: [New] Autopilot rolls out in Frontier from 17 November: an always-on Copilot agent with its own account, mailbox and remote computer; off until an admin enables it
item.description:
Each Autopilot is a new identity with a mailbox and a remote computer acting on delegated goals over time — a new principal type for sign-in, mailbox audit and DLP coverage.

Copilot · If the tenant is in Frontier, decide who may enable Autopilot, and confirm Autopilot identities appear in Entra Agent ID inventory and in mailbox audit before the first one is created.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Copilot Studio workflows can be owned by a service principal instead of a user account (GA by 17 December)
item.description:
Workflows owned by app registrations move automation out of user sign-in monitoring and into workload-identity monitoring, where credential hygiene is often weaker.

Copilot Studio · Require owners and credential expiry review for any app registration used to own Copilot Studio workflows; include them in workload identity Conditional Access if licensed.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due today] Workforce Insights endpoint in MODS retires 18 November; custom non-public attributes such as job level move to the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint and become visible to Copilot experiences
item.description:
Non-public HR attributes such as job level that were scoped to one Frontier agent become available to Copilot experiences generally once they move to the profile endpoint, which is a data-exposure decision for privacy and governance, not a plumbing change.

Copilot · deadline 2026-11-18 · If you upload custom attributes to the Workforce Insights endpoint, list them, agree an access policy with privacy stakeholders, then re-select the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint before 18 November.

item.description:
